title: Village Tank Silt Warning Gauge
problem: Our village tank holds very little water in summer because thick mud silt has filled up the tank bottom over many years.
idea: A silt checker. The camera reads the depth marker post and shows if the tank needs desilting. You can also calculate how much space the silt has taken.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What does the marker post show?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine looks at photos of the painted depth post in the dry tank. Tap what the camera sees.
widgets.question: Silt on the marker post has reached:

options.label: Below the green mark
options.result: Silt is low. The tank is healthy. Check again next summer.

options.label: Up to the yellow mark
options.result: Silt is building up. Plan desilting in the next summer.

options.label: Above the red mark
options.result: ALERT! Too much silt. Tell the Panchayat to desilt the tank this summer.
options.te: హెచ్చరిక! పూడిక చాలా ఎక్కువ. పంచాయతీకి చెప్పండి.
options.tip: Desilted tank soil is rich and farmers can use it in their fields.

widgets.heading: 🧮 How much of the tank is filled with silt?
widgets.intro: Measure on the marker post when the tank is dry.
widgets.formula: if (!(fulldepth > 0 && silt >= 0) || silt > fulldepth) return null; var p = silt / fulldepth * 100; return {p: Math.round(p), left: Math.round(100 - p), level: p >= 30 ? 'bad' : (p >= 15 ? 'warn' : 'good'), msg: p >= 30 ? 'Desilting needed soon!' : (p >= 15 ? 'Keep watching every year.' : 'Tank is in good shape.')};

how: With an adult, paint green, yellow and red marks on a post in the dry tank bed.
Take photos of the post with silt at different levels (you can also use a bucket model at school).
In Teachable Machine, make 3 classes: Low, Medium, High silt. Train and Export.
In Scratch, load the model with TM2Scratch and show a coloured alert for each class.
Ask Gemini how desilted soil helps farmers, and add that message.
Share the result with the Gram Panchayat before summer.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Explain in simple English and Telugu why silt reduces water in our village tank, and how desilting in summer and using the silt in fields helps farmers.
